description:
Outcome: coordinator allocates plots and places unallocated applicants on FIFO waiting list, from brief.md First version 2/Rules.
Scope: application/preferences review, available-plot selector, priority queues, transactional assign/reassign/release, batch waitlist transition, confirmed promotion and history. Excludes: map/holder overview, preference optimization, allocation emails and time-limited offers.
Acceptance: initial allocation prohibited before February 1 00:00 garden time; prior-season holders applying before cutoff precede others; returning applicants at/after cutoff join new applicants in ordinary submission order. Within category FIFO with stable ties. No duplicate plot/household allocation under concurrency. Waiting list preserves original application order; promotion, direct assignment and reassignment cannot bypass it. Unavailable preferences do not discard applicants.
Behaviour: reject/refresh stale conflicting writes; explicit empty/full states; confirm reassignment; audit withdrawals.
Verification: business-rule TDD, timezone/cutoff/ties/concurrent assignment/promotion; January new applicant followed by just-before-cutoff returner; exact-cutoff late-returner case and premature allocation rejection. Prerequisites: prototype checkpoint and seasonal application. Assumptions: no plot guarantee; coordinator confirms promotion and handles withdrawals explicitly.
title: Allocation and ordered waiting list
